_about: Every character that can talk in a cutscene. name = what the text box shows; type_speed = letters per second; voice = the babble (pitch multiplies 440 Hz, 'every' = one blip per that many letters, variation = how far the pitch wanders, length in seconds, wave 'soft' or 'buzz', volume_db); shots = camera framings by name (distance/height/look_height in meters from the character's origin, yaw in degrees from straight in front, optional y = absolute camera height, track/follow for moving targets).
